WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.TITLE: Templates
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.DESCRIPTION: View the message templates synced from your WhatsApp inboxes. To create or edit a template, manage it with your provider.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.FETCH_ERROR: Unable to load WhatsApp templates. Please try again.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.PARTIAL_FETCH_ERROR: Some WhatsApp templates could not be loaded. Please try again.

PREVIEW.TITLE: Template preview
PREVIEW.DESCRIPTION: Preview how this template appears in WhatsApp.

NAME.LABEL: Template name
NAME.HELP: Automatically formatted: lowercase letters, numbers and underscores.
NAME.LOCKED: The name cannot be changed after creation.

HEADER_FORMAT.LABEL: Header format
HEADER_FORMAT.LOCKED: The header format cannot be changed after creation.

BODY.LABEL: Body
BODY.PLACEHOLDER: Hi {'{{'}customer_name{'}}'}, your order {'{{'}order_id{'}}'} has been confirmed.
BODY.HELP: Use {'{{'}name{'}}'} for named variables or {'{{'}1{'}}'} for numbered ones — do not mix the two.

ERRORS.INVALID_NAME: The name must contain only lowercase letters, numbers and underscores.
ERRORS.BODY_EXAMPLE_MISMATCH: Provide a sample value for every body variable.
ERRORS.HEADER_EXAMPLE_MISMATCH: Provide a sample value for every header variable.
ERRORS.BUTTON_LABEL_TOO_LONG: Button labels must be 25 characters or shorter.
ERRORS.INVALID_BUTTON_URL: URL buttons accept at most one variable, and it must be at the end of the URL.
ERRORS.MEDIA_REQUIRED: Upload a file for the media header.
ERRORS.UPLOAD_FAILED: Could not upload the file. Please try again.
ERRORS.INVALID_VARIABLE_NAME: The variable {name} must use lowercase letters, numbers and single underscores between words.
ERRORS.MIXED_VARIABLES: Use either named or numbered variables across the whole template, not both.
ERRORS.COPY_CODE_REQUIRED: Copy code buttons need a sample code.
ERRORS.COPY_CODE_TOO_LONG: The code must be 15 characters or shorter.
ERRORS.COPY_CODE_LIMIT: A template supports at most one copy code button.
ERRORS.PAYMENT_BUTTON_ALONE: A payment button cannot be combined with other buttons.

WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.CREATE_SUCCESS: Template submitted to Meta for approval.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.CREATE_ERROR: Could not create the template. Please try again.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.DELETE_ERROR: Could not delete the template. Please try again.

CREATE.TITLE: New template
CREATE.DESCRIPTION: Submit a template to Meta for approval. It stays pending until Meta reviews it.

DELETE.TITLE: Delete template
DELETE.DESCRIPTION: This deletes {name} on Meta and cannot be undone.

EDIT.TITLE: Edit template
EDIT.DESCRIPTION: Only the content changes. Name, language, category and header format are fixed, and the template goes back to Meta for review.

WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.UPDATE_SUCCESS: Template submitted to Meta for review.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.UPDATE_ERROR: Could not update the template. Please try again.
